accessPoints.name: Blue Point Day Use Area (Lower Salt)
accessPoints.note: Current USFS page explicitly documents tubing and river access at this coordinate. Individual imagery shows the parking lot north of Bush Highway, east of the river. Keep this as an approximate Area marker; do not substitute the different Pebble Beach shore south of the bridge.

accessPoints.name: Goldfield Day Use Area (Lower Salt)
accessPoints.note: Current USFS page explicitly documents a river access and tubing take-out. Its coordinate identifies the inland approach/parking area, about 250 m from the river, not the water entry. The current page warns of seasonal eagle restrictions; this review does not certify future winter access.

accessPoints.name: Husum (above the falls)
accessPoints.note: Current USFS page identifies this boating/portage facility and publishes the unchanged candidate coordinate. Individual imagery places it at the roadside pull-out upstream of the visible falls. Preserve Area precision: the water-entry path and take-out eddy are under tree cover. Missing the upstream exit can lead into Class V Husum Falls.

accessPoints.name: Water Users Day Use Area (Lower Salt)
accessPoints.note: IMAGERY-PLACED: coordinate is owner-supplied (North's own Google Maps satellite marking, 33.5541561, -111.5433992) and checked on Esri World Imagery z19 on 2026-10-26 (research/raw/imagery/water_users_day_use_area_lower_salt_owner_z19.png); it is NOT an agency coordinate. On imagery: North's point sits on the open sand clearing where the foot paths from the day-use parking lot reach the north bank, about 10-20 m from the channel edge across a bare silt/gravel bar; no constructed ramp (natural shore launch). The USFS EDW point (recareaid 35407) is in the paved lot about 156 m north. The waterline moves with Stewart Mountain Dam releases. NHD High Resolution flowline 37 m away. Superseded agency point: USFS EDW Recreation Opportunities, recareaid 35407 'Water Users Day Use Area' (same coordinate on the Tonto NF page) at 33.555518, -111.543833 (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_RecreationOpportunities_01/MapServer/0/query?where=recareaid%3D35407&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=json). Legal boating access: USDA Forest Service, Tonto NF: Water Users Day Use Area (Site Open) (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r03/tonto/recreation/water-users-day-use-area): 'Water Users is a popular site for kayakers and tubers.' 'This site is most popular as a launch site' 'Motorized boats are not allowed to launch at this site.' Tonto Daily Pass (and Watercraft Sticker, if required). Spot-check this point first; imagery date is not published by Esri.

accessPoints.name: Phon D Sutton Day Use Area (Lower Salt)
accessPoints.note: IMAGERY-PLACED: coordinate is owner-supplied (North's own Google Maps satellite marking, 33.5465461, -111.6616464) and checked on Esri World Imagery z19 on 2026-10-26 (research/raw/imagery/phon_d_sutton_day_use_area_lower_salt_owner_z19.png); it is NOT an agency coordinate. On imagery: North's point sits at the waterline on the south bank of the Salt, on an open sandy/rocky shore reached by foot paths from the western Phon D Sutton parking lots and ramadas, just below the Verde River confluence (the Verde enters from the north opposite). No constructed ramp (natural shore take-out). The Tonto NF page point (EDW recareaid 35397) is in the eastern parking lot about 420 m east (60 m south of the river there); the paved site road links both lot groups, and EDW lists no other recreation site between Raccoon Bluff (1.7 km upstream) and this point. The waterline moves with Salt and Verde dam releases. NHD High Resolution flowline 17 m away. Superseded agency point: Tonto NF Phon D Sutton page coordinate (USFS EDW Recreation Opportunities recareaid 35397 'Phon D Sutton Day Use Area': 33.547016, -111.657843) at 33.54697106, -111.6571505 (https://apps.fs.usda.gov/arcx/rest/services/EDW/EDW_RecreationOpportunities_01/MapServer/0/query?where=recareaid%3D35397&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=json). Legal boating access: USDA Forest Service, Tonto NF: Phon D Sutton Day Use Area (Site Open) (https://www.fs.usda.gov/r03/tonto/recreation/phon-d-sutton-day-use-area): 'This site is a popular inner tube take-out point.' Tonto Daily Pass (and Watercraft Sticker, if required). Spot-check this point first; imagery date is not published by Esri.

accessPoints.name: BZ Corner
accessPoints.note: USFS confirms the launch, take-outs and trail open; toilets are seasonally closed. INFRA site 76009 matches this existing approximate agency coordinate. The imagery does not establish an exact parking loop or shoreline entry at the pin. The river is east of the marker; retain Area precision and agency directions.
